name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns Mali's military rulers for dissolving political parties in May 2025 and for cracking down on the opposition. It calls on Mali to hold elections, release people arrested for political reasons, and respect human rights. It also asks European Union officials and member states to raise these concerns with Mali's authorities.

- The Parliament asks Mali's rulers to restore democracy and free political prisoners; nothing changes automatically.
- It affects Mali's opposition, activists and civil society, and European Union diplomacy with Mali.
- Next, European Union officials and member states are asked to raise these concerns with Mali's authorities.
